notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 — Weather + Balcony + Window View
notes.notes:
Hello! How are you all doing, folks?

I’ve added dynamic day-night cycles, as well as a balcony and a view outside the window. With optimization complexity... well, blame Lumen for that—it’s not my fault! Point your fingers at it and Unreal Engine 5! If you turn off that darn Lumen, the graphics will become very simple, even on Ultra settings.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/770599e7f68461e26433ad3d921ec81c31e4c73c.png

I’ve fixed minor bugs, like toggling the room light with a single click—previously, it didn’t turn on/off right away.

I’ve also added a test balcony... aaaand... weather! Day and night will now cycle every 10 minutes of real time. Right now, I’m thinking about adding the stairwell and how to exit there, followed by the street.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/cce66790be7c92df99d7b6d231d3abeab476d29a.png

I’ll be keeping an eye on your feedback—for now, this is only available on one map (KHRUSHCHEVKA).

Alright, I’ve typed too much already. If you have any questions, feel free to join the Discord—I’ll respond quickly there.

Have a great week, everyone!

notes.title: 🎉 Patch 1.0.7 — Game Save + Collision
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

:3 Here's another patch 👩‍🔧, and this time it's all about SAVING all in-game items! (Save by pressing - "H")

💾SAVING

I've been working hard these past few days on the game's save system and achieved some results. Now you can save all objects in the game without any losses, except for wallpapers and linoleums (I think this will be fixed very soon).

Save - H

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/ed79f318cb9fad4877c52a8a2e0403e279027400.png

✅ COLLISION

As requested, I've made it so that large objects (like cabinets, refrigerators, etc.) no longer clip through walls. (See GIF below)

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/2812b3320292d7b429a7b3e7c1b6aeda1f76f080.gif

✅ SNAPPING TO WALLS

If you want to place an object right next to a wall, simply bring it close to the surface — it will automatically align itself. (See GIF below)

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/ff378e7367e27cd60832391137440085d5cc72a1.gif

✅ + Fixed a bug where boxes were falling through textures in the garage section.

Have a great weekend, everyone! 🤗

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 — Saving + New Items
notes.notes:
Hello, dear friends! 🙂

I’ve implemented partial saving and loading of objects. There are some issues with wallpapers and linoleum. Why partial? Because objects placed on tables, for example, disappear. I think I’ll soon figure out this "little rat" 🐀, but larger objects save just fine.

ːsteamthisːSaving is on - H.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/a9da435b187795688d1bd8bc2ad833b984c66b3a.png

As requested, I’ve added the following items:

Separate kitchen cabinets (now you can place them however you like)

Range hood

2000s-style refrigerator

2000s-style water meter

Toilet pipe and more

Water pipes (you can connect them in various ways, let your imagination run wild)

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/1a74d46a16f6e063628af5e9a8ca5c127ea39e8c.png

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/a921c44f4c3b6d704df26f7b5032e9216e49ea18.png

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/dd65f344fd3189cfa747fc0affe8648212f8d2cf.png

About turning off the lights.
Guys, I’m curious to know your thoughts: do you need a complete light switch-off, or should it be like on the "Kitchen" map, where the lights just dim? You can simply turn them on/off with the T button.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/a06f42397439dccbbfbeb579891a58448d160c61.png

About Changing Images for Posters and Stickers

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45329340/ec81a8a0ab739b4b154af9e1fadbee3f1aed7f80.png

I noticed that many people don’t know how to change the textures for these items. You need to place them on the scene and select the brush icon. (I added the label "Poster (edit)" so you don’t get confused).

Wishing you all a productive week! 🎯

To be continued! �️‍♀️

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 — UI Improvements + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 👋

Here come the patches. I’ve read your feedback and suggestions and decided to start with the interface. Various issues have also been fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329340/57c1b9eabaaafdc025aae19f185f6011c92ec13a.png

[olist]
 Fixed the bug with black dots.
Some players encountered strange black dots on the screen (the issue was related to one of the materials).

 Added a button to delete objects.
A new button has been added to the interface, allowing players to quickly delete objects.

 Updated the instructions.
A new guide has been added to help players better understand the gameplay.

 Separated names for rugs.
Wall and floor rugs now have different names for easier identification.

 Changed the way to open the menu.
The menu now opens with the Esc key instead of a button.

 Reduced movement speed.
The speed of movement and camera flight has been decreased for a more comfortable gameplay experience.

 Added a scroll box to the interface for easier browsing of materials (e.g., wallpapers).

 Fixed the interaction between curtains and windowsills.
Resolved the issue where curtains would clip through windowsills and radiators.

 Optimized the scroll box for materials.
Improved the functionality of the scroll box for materials to make it more user-friendly.
[/olist]

To be continued...
